description: Figure 4 of Sluka et al. 2016 (PLOS ONE 11(9): e0162428, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0162428, CC BY 4.0): a standalone simulation of the whole-body PBPK module with parameter set REFSIM, a 1.4 g oral acetaminophen (APAP) dose in a 70 kg male, venous APAP in ug/mL against time in hours. The line is the model output (APAP_sim); the open squares are in vivo data and are not read. Read by scripts/digitize_figure_panels.py in its dark-line mode: the frame and the grey ticks inside it are located in the image, and the line is followed by continuity from a column it has to itself. Read by eye: that each frame edge carries its axis's 0 label, that each tick is one unit (an hour, or 1 ug/mL) from the last, and that the labelled ticks fall every 5. The line leaves the plot's lower-left corner, its first sample, and is read from there.

defaults.digitizer: scripts/digitize_figure_panels.py (dark-line trace; axis labels read by eye)

panels.figure: Sluka et al. 2016, Fig 4 (venous APAP, REFSIM)

series.curve: venous APAP after a 1.4 g oral dose (APAP_sim line)
